description.en: Four perspectives on money, income, consumption and incentives: How to Make Your First Million, The Rat Race, The Cobra Effect, and Idols. Reading for understanding money and reviewing financial decisions.

description.en: Sigma: The Royal Male and Sigma: Captivating Femininity — two complementary adult reads about understanding men and women, communication and intimacy within marriage. Both books cost $20 together when priced in USD.
